query: I want to approach some creative coding work with the hacker ethic, but I am not sure whether I should build a rough artifact or refine something that already works. Help me choose the right Hackinator mode.
expected_behavior: Selects using-hackinator because the user explicitly needs help choosing a mode
Distinguishes builder from whittler and routes based on whether a working artifact exists
Does not begin a concrete build or craft pass before that choice is known
